_comment: Locked series voice for Claudia. Copy into your prompt library; never change mid-series. Values for @useclaudia/media meta.voiceSettings (ElevenLabs).

design.prompt: A woman in her late twenties with a soft, low-mid pitched voice and a smile in it. Relaxed, unhurried pacing with a light New York lilt, never a caricature. Warm and a little dry, as if telling a close friend something funny late at night. Clear consonants, laughs easily and lightly, drops to a near-whisper for asides. Close-mic, intimate, studio-clean recording with no background noise, no music.
